explanation: Symbol resolution is the process of associating names in a program (symbols) with their corresponding memory addresses during the linking and loading process.  Name mangling is a crucial part of this, transforming source code names into unique object file names to prevent conflicts.  This ensures that the linker can correctly match function and variable references across multiple object files, even if those files were compiled from different source code modules or use the same names for different entities (overloading).  Without robust symbol resolution and mangling, linking would be impossible or result in incorrect program behavior.
keywords: Name Mangling, Symbol Resolution, Linker Symbols, Name Decoration
